lines.en: label pornshop15:
scene pornshophhg
I show up at the porn shop to find it in...slightly different condition than normal.
lines.zh: 我来到色情用品店，发现它的状况……和平时略有不同。

lines.en: Previously, all of the posters covering the wall had seemed relatively low-resolution- like they were printed out on paper and just taped up or something.
lines.zh: 以前，墙上贴的那些海报看上去分辨率都挺低的——像是打印在纸上、然后随便用胶带粘上去之类的。

lines.en: But it looks like a whole plethora of new posters have been hung now. And they’re all advertising the same thing.
lines.zh: 但现在看来，新挂上了一大批海报。而且它们全都在宣传同一样东西。

lines.en: The fuck is {i}Hero's Harem Guild?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Hero's Harem Guild{/i}到底是他妈的什么鬼东西？

lines.en: I take a look around to see if I can spot Makoto, but I-
lines.zh: 我四处张望，想看看能不能找到 Makoto，可我——

lines.en: : This...fucking...stupid...game...
lines.zh: : 这……该死的……蠢……游戏……

lines.en: : Makoto? Where are you?
lines.zh: : Makoto？你在哪儿？

lines.en: : Over here, bashing my head against a wall.
lines.zh: : 在这儿，拿头撞墙呢。

lines.en: : What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你想干嘛？

lines.en: : Uhh...porn? Did you forget what you sell here?
lines.zh: : 呃……买片？你忘了你们这儿卖什么的？

lines.en: : Go home and watch porn on your computer.
lines.zh: : 回家用你的电脑看片去。

lines.en: scene makotohhg1
: Nah, I think I’ll just watch whatever you’re-
lines.zh: : 不，我想我就看你正在——

lines.en: : Are you...fishing?
lines.zh: : 你在……钓鱼？

lines.en: : What does it look like I’m doing, genius? Of course I’m fishing.
lines.zh: : 天才，你看我像是在干嘛？我当然是在钓鱼。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Some weird guy showed up an hour ago and just started hanging up all these weird posters for some video game he’s making.
lines.zh: : 一个小时前有个怪男人跑来，开始张贴这些莫名其妙的海报，宣传他在做的某个电子游戏。

lines.en: jump makotohhgx
label makotohhgx:
: A video game? But this is a porn shop.
lines.zh: : 电子游戏？可这是家色情用品店啊。

lines.en: scene makotohhg2
: They have pornographic video games too, you know. We just haven’t really sold any since we opened.
lines.zh: : 色情电子游戏也是有的，你知道吧。只是我们开店以来基本没卖出去过。

lines.en: : But my mom said that we need to start selling them now since we’re getting less and less male customers.
lines.zh: : 可我妈说，既然男顾客越来越少，我们现在得开始卖这些东西了。

lines.en: : Okay, but that still doesn’t really explain why you’re fishing.
lines.zh: : 好吧，可这还是没解释你为什么在钓鱼啊。

lines.en: scene makotohhg1
: Yes, I’m well aware. I have no idea why I have to do this either.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我很清楚。我自己也不知道为什么非得干这个。

lines.en: : My wrist is starting to hurt and everything.
lines.zh: : 而且我的手腕都开始疼了。

lines.en: : Correct me if I’m wrong here, but hurting your wrist playing a porn game sounds kind of par for the course.
lines.zh: : 要是我说错了你可以纠正我，不过玩色情游戏玩到手腕疼，听起来倒是意料之中的事。

lines.en: : Ha ha ha. I’m funny. My name is Sensei. I make masturbation jokes. I’m a boy. Ha ha ha ha.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。我好幽默。我叫 Sensei。我专讲打飞机的笑话。我是个男的。哈哈哈哈。

lines.en: : Woah, what’s gotten into you all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 哇哦，你这是突然吃错什么药了？

lines.en: scene makotohhg3
: All I want to do is have sex with cute girls and beat this game but I need to fish before I can do that!
lines.zh: : 我只想和可爱的女孩们做爱、再把这游戏通关，可我得先钓完鱼才能做那些！

lines.en: : What does fishing have to do with sex?
lines.zh: : 钓鱼和做爱有什么关系？

lines.en: : Hell if I know! If you ever try to win my heart with a fish, I’ll kill you! I swear!
lines.zh: : 鬼才知道！你要是敢拿一条鱼来博取我的芳心，我就杀了你！我发誓！

lines.en: if pornshop10 == True:
: I didn’t need a fish to win your heart. I just needed to get you alone in the back room.
lines.zh: : 我赢得你的心可没用上鱼。我只用把你单独弄进里屋就够了。

lines.en: scene makotohhg1
: Yeah, well...You’re a jerk. Take that. Jerky McJerkface.
lines.zh: : 是、是吗……你就是个混蛋。接招吧，混蛋中的混蛋。

lines.en: : Harsh.
lines.zh: : 真狠。

lines.en: else:
: Really? Well, there go my plans for next weekend.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那我下周末的计划泡汤了。

lines.en: : Here I was hoping to win you over with exactly that.
lines.zh: : 我本来还指望就靠那条鱼把你追到手呢。

lines.en: scene makotohhg1
: You’re the absolute worst. Even worse than whatever this weird fish is.
lines.zh: : 你真是世上最讨厌的人。比这条奇怪的鱼还讨厌。

lines.en: Makoto fills up a meter on the screen and a fish pops into her inventory.
lines.zh: Makoto 把屏幕上的一条计量槽填满，一条鱼跳进了她的背包。

lines.en: : What’s that one called? It looks like it has a name.
lines.zh: : 那条叫什么？看起来好像有名字。

lines.en: : The game says it’s called a Danee fish.
lines.zh: : 游戏里说它叫 Danee 鱼。

lines.en: : Does it...do anything?
lines.zh: : 它有……什么用吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. But it’s ugly and I’m throwing it back.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。不过它很丑，我要把它扔回去。

lines.en: "Makoto deletes the fish from her inventory and continues
lines.zh: Makoto 把鱼从背包里删掉，继续

lines.en: repeating the same motions with her wrist until it gets dark in the game."
lines.zh: 用手腕重复着同样的动作，直到游戏里的天色变暗。

lines.en: : Do we get to have sex with the girls now? I like the one with the orange hair on the poster in front of you. Bang her first.
lines.zh: : 现在我们能跟那些女孩做爱了吧？我喜欢你前面海报上那个橙色头发的。先上她。

lines.en: : That’s Lucy. She’s the best. I think I need more fish before we can sleep with her, though.
lines.zh: : 那是 Lucy。她最棒了。不过我觉得还得再钓几条鱼才能睡到她。

lines.en: : Just how many fish do you need?...
lines.zh: : 你到底需要多少条鱼啊？……

lines.en: : Let’s see...I just have to bring these to some weird girl who buys them and-
lines.zh: : 我看看……我只要把这些拿给某个收购鱼的怪女孩，然后——

lines.en: scene makotohhg4
: Done with the prologue yet, dear?
lines.zh: : 序章打完了吗，亲爱的？

lines.en: : Huh?
scene makotohhg5
: Mom?! Wh-What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 妈？！你、你在干什么？

lines.en: scene makotohhg6
: And what are you wearing?!
lines.zh: : 还有你穿的是什么啊？！

lines.en: scene makotohhg7
: What’s wrong with what I’m wearing? I didn’t have the energy to get dressed. Is that a crime?
lines.zh: : 我这身穿着有什么问题？我没力气好好穿衣服而已。这算犯罪吗？

lines.en: : It is when you run a business!
lines.zh: : 你开着店的时候就算！

lines.en: q "Makoto, my beautiful child, we sell DVDs where
lines.zh: q 「Makoto，我美丽的孩子，我们卖的 DVD 里，成群的男人对着

lines.en: groups of men jerk off onto[school]girls. Dressing up for the job will not give us back our dignity."
lines.zh: [school]女孩打飞机。为这份工作打扮得光鲜，也换不回我们的尊严。」

lines.en: scene makotohhg8
: That’s disgusting! We sell things like that here?!
lines.zh: : 太恶心了！我们这儿居然卖那种东西？！

lines.en: : How do you not know that?...It’s one of the most popular choices among older men.
lines.zh: : 你怎么会不知道？……那可是上了年纪的男人里最受欢迎的选择之一。

lines.en: : I’m personally into the more...individual-focused tapes. Groups of more than three get kind of hard to follow.
lines.zh: : 我个人的口味更偏向……聚焦单个人的片子。超过三个人就有点看不过来了。

lines.en: scene makotohhg9
: Guh...
: Ahh, a man of culture I see. I’m Maki, the store’s-
lines.zh: : 啊，看得出来是位懂行的先生。我是 Maki，本店的——

lines.en: scene makotohhg10
Makoto’s mother suddenly pauses and observes me for a second.
lines.zh: Makoto 的母亲突然顿住，打量了我一秒。

lines.en: It’s almost like she’s...
lines.zh: 那感觉几乎像是她在……

lines.en: ...Recognizing someone.
lines.zh: ……认出了什么人。

lines.en: Oh God. This could be bad.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。这下不妙了。

lines.en: : Aren’t you...my daughter’s[school] teacher?
lines.zh: : 你不是……我女儿的[school]老师吗？

lines.en: scene makotohhg11
: Wait, Mom! You can’t just be...asking the customers for their identities! Isn’t there like...a law against that or something.
lines.zh: : 等等，妈！你不能就这么……向顾客打听人家的身份吧！难道就没有……什么法律禁止这种事之类的吗？

lines.en: : There isn’t. And if you’ve been selling things to our customers without checking their IDs, I’m grounding you for the next month.
lines.zh: : 没有。而且你要是一直没查顾客身份证就把东西卖出去，我就禁你的足，禁一个月。

lines.en: There’s no way out of this. There can’t be.
lines.zh: 这下无路可退了。不可能有。

lines.en: "I mean, technically, I could probably just book it and dash out of the store
lines.zh: 我是说，严格来讲，我大概也可以拔腿就跑、冲出店门，

lines.en: to avoid having an awkward conversation but..."
lines.zh: 来避开一场尴尬的对话，不过……

lines.en: I can’t imagine that would make things any easier for Makoto.
lines.zh: 我想象不出那样会让 Makoto 的日子好过一点。

lines.en: "I should probably just be honest...or at least mostly honest. I’m sure
lines.zh: 我大概还是该说实话……或者至少说个大半的真话。我想，

lines.en: something like “I didn’t realize she worked here” will suffice given the circumstances."
lines.zh: 在这种情况下，一句「我不知道她在这儿打工」之类的应该就够了。

lines.en: scene makotohhg12
: That’s right. It’s nice to see you again, Maki.
lines.zh: : 没错。很高兴又见面了，Maki。

lines.en: : Likewise. Thanks for stopping in.
lines.zh: : 我也是。谢谢你光临。

lines.en: : This...Uhh...
maki "This isn’t going to get Makoto into any trouble, is it? Because
lines.zh: maki 「这不会给 Makoto 惹上什么麻烦吧？因为

lines.en: it’s 100%% my fault that she’s working here."
lines.zh: 她在这儿打工，100%% 是我的错。」

lines.en: : It’s just that ever since her father was drafted, I’ve been running everything myself and-
lines.zh: : 只是自从她父亲被征召之后，一切都是我一个人在操持，而且——

lines.en: : What? No, that’s fine. I don’t care about that at all.
lines.zh: : 什么？不，没关系。我一点也不在意那个。

lines.en: scene makotohhg13
: Wait, really? I could have sworn this wasn’t going to end well for anybody.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？我还敢打包票说这事对谁都不会有好结果呢。

lines.en: : Could it be that we’re all going to have a happy ending after all?
lines.zh: : 难道说，我们最后全都能有个圆满的结局？

lines.en: : That’s not a massage joke, by the way. We don’t offer those here.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，那可不是按摩的梗。我们这儿不提供那种服务。

lines.en: if pornshop10 == True:
scene makotohhg14
Heh.
lines.zh: 呵。

lines.en: If only she knew...
lines.zh: 她要是知道了……

lines.en: Actually, no. It would be catastrophic if she knew.
lines.zh: 不过算了。她要是真的知道，那将是灾难性的。

lines.en: Let’s avoid that at all costs.
lines.zh: 无论如何都得避免那种事。

lines.en: else:
scene makotohhg15
: Mom!
scene makotohhg15
: What do you think you’re doing?! You can’t make jokes like that in front of my teacher!
lines.zh: : 你这是在干什么？！你不能当着我老师的面开那种玩笑！

lines.en: scene makotohhg16
: I can’t?! But those are the only jokes I know!
lines.zh: : 不能吗？！可我只会讲那种笑话啊！

lines.en: : That’s because all you ever think about is porn!
lines.zh: : 那是因为你脑子里除了色情就没别的东西！

lines.en: : I think about other things too! Like...dogs...and...the...stock market.
lines.zh: : 我也想别的事情啊！比如……狗……还有……那个……股票市场。

lines.en: mak "You have never talked about the stock market even once in your life! You probably
lines.zh: mak 「你这辈子连一次都没聊过股票市场！你

lines.en: don’t even know what a stock is!"
lines.zh: 大概连股票是什么都不知道！」

lines.en: scene makotohhg17r
: She’s not this bad in[school], is she? I’d feel horrible if that were the case.
lines.zh: : 她在[school]里不会也这么糟吧？如果是的话，我会很难过的。

lines.en: : Mom! Stop!
lines.zh: : 妈！别说了！

lines.en: : Makoto is actually the top student in class. She’s actually been even more helpful than usual lately.
lines.zh: : Makoto 其实是班上的尖子生。而且她最近比平时还要更帮得上忙。

lines.en: scene makotohhg17
: Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : Really? That’s great news.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？这可是个好消息。

lines.en: : In fact, to celebrate such a joyous occasion, how about I give you 50%% off anything in the store?
lines.zh: : 其实，为了庆祝这么值得高兴的事，店里的东西我给你减 50%%，怎么样？

lines.en: scene makotohhg18
: My daughter is off-limits, though. Got it, Sensei?~
lines.zh: : 不过我女儿可不能碰。明白了吗，Sensei？～

lines.en: I go through a quick inner struggle in figuring out whether or not it would be acceptable to joke back about that, but I decide against it for the time being.
lines.zh: 我内心迅速挣扎了一下，琢磨着回一句这种玩笑合不合适，但暂时还是决定算了。

lines.en: I should at least get to know Maki a little better before playing along with her mildly perverted sense of humor.
lines.zh: 起码我该先多了解一下 Maki，再顺着她那点轻度色情的幽默感往下接。

lines.en: : Thanks a lot. I’ll take a look around now.
lines.zh: : 太感谢了。那我四处看看。

lines.en: maki "Great. I planned on taking over for Makoto tonight anyway, so I’ll
lines.zh: maki 「好啊。反正我今晚本来就打算接替 Makoto，所以

lines.en: ring you up while she gathers her things and heads home."
lines.zh: 等她收拾东西回家的时候，我来给你结账。」

lines.en: scene makotohhg19
: Wait, really? I can go?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？我可以走了？

lines.en: : Are you going to be okay closing up? You worked all day, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你一个人收店没问题吗？你都工作一整天了吧？

lines.en: : Define “work” because I kind of just sat around for a really long time. I’m fine to close up.
lines.zh: : 先定义一下什么叫「工作」吧，我基本上只是坐着发了好久的呆。收店我没问题的。

lines.en: : Do you need me to call you a cab back to the dorms?
lines.zh: : 需要我帮你叫辆出租车回宿舍吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s fine. I’ll walk. The weather’s kind of nice anyway.
lines.zh: : 不用，没事。我走回去。反正天气还不错。

lines.en: scene makotohhg20
"Despite not saying anything, I’m pretty sure Makoto is
lines.zh: 尽管她什么都没说，但我敢肯定 Makoto

lines.en: thinking something along the lines of “Don’t you dare try doing anything weird to my mom while I’m gone.”"
lines.zh: 心里想的差不多是「我不在的时候，你敢对我妈动什么歪脑筋试试」。

lines.en: And to that, my dear Makoto, I say-
lines.zh: 而对此，我亲爱的 Makoto，我的回答是——

lines.en: “I make no promises.”
lines.zh: 「我什么都不保证。」

lines.en: scene black
Makoto gathers up a few things she had stashed behind the counter and exits the store after saying her goodbyes.
lines.zh: Makoto 把藏在柜台后的几样东西收拢起来，道别后走出了店门。

lines.en: "I browse the racks without assistance for a few minutes before deciding on some random, relatively vanilla DVD so
lines.zh: 我没人陪同，自己在货架间逛了几分钟，最后随手挑了张相对清淡的 DVD，

lines.en: Maki doesn’t think I’m too weird right off the bat..."
lines.zh: 好让 Maki 别一上来就觉得我太变态……

lines.en: scene makotohhg21
: All set?
lines.zh: : 选好了？

lines.en: : Yeah. This will be all.
lines.zh: : 嗯。就这些。

lines.en: Maki scans the DVD with one of those cool price gun things and doesn’t pay much mind to what’s on the cover.
lines.zh: Maki 用那种很酷的标价枪似的东西扫了扫那张 DVD，对封面上的内容并没太在意。

lines.en: : I’m going to give you my number as well. Is that okay?
lines.zh: : 我还想把我的号码给你。可以吗？

lines.en: : What? Really? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？真的吗？为什么？

lines.en: : Same reason I gave it to you at the last parent-teacher meeting. To check in on my daughter.
lines.zh: : 和上次家长会上我把号码给你是同一个理由。好了解我女儿的情况。

lines.en: scene makotohhg22
maki "She works herself a little too hard sometimes, and I want you to let me
lines.zh: maki 「她有时候把自己逼得太紧了，我想让你

lines.en: know if you ever think it starts affecting her."
lines.zh: 一旦觉得那开始影响到她，就告诉我一声。」

lines.en: : And since you hadn’t called yet, I figured you might have lost the number or something, so...
lines.zh: : 而既然你一直没打过来，我就想你可能把号码弄丢了什么的，所以……

lines.en: Huh...did I already have Maki’s number in my contact list?
lines.zh: 嗯……我的通讯录里本来就有 Maki 的号码吗？

lines.en: I can’t remember ever really sorting through it, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: 现在想想，我不记得自己真的整理过通讯录。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll definitely do that.
lines.zh: : 当然。我一定会的。

lines.en: : Makoto’s fine, though. She’s actually pretty remarkable.
lines.zh: : 不过 Makoto 很好。她其实相当了不起。

lines.en: scene makotohhg23
: Well she doesn’t get it from me, I can tell you that much.
lines.zh: : 反正这点我可以肯定，她不是随我。

lines.en: : 1500 Yen is your total after the discount.
lines.zh: : 打折后一共是 1500 日元。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。

lines.en: I take some money out of my pocket and slide it across the table to Maki.
lines.zh: 我从口袋里掏出些钱，把它从台面上滑给 Maki。

lines.en: It’s exact change, so she just shoves it into the register and slams the drawer.
lines.zh: 钱正好不用找，于是她直接把它塞进收银机，砰地关上抽屉。

lines.en: scene makotohhg21
: Come back soon, okay? And be sure to try out that new game we’re promoting.
lines.zh: : 下次再来啊，好吗？还有一定要试试我们在推的那款新游戏。

lines.en: : There’s one girl in it who gets turned on by getting hit in the head with a frying pan. It’s sweet.
lines.zh: : 里面有个女孩，被平底锅砸到头就会有感觉。挺温馨的。

lines.en: : I’ll keep it in mind. Thanks for the recommendation.
lines.zh: : 我会记着的。谢谢你的推荐。

lines.en: : Don’t mention it! I’ll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 别客气！回头见。

lines.en: : That you will.
lines.zh: : 一定会的。

lines.en: scene black
I take the receipt with Maki’s number on it and type it into my phone as I walk out of the store.
lines.zh: 我拿着印有 Maki 号码的收据，一边走出店门，一边把它输进手机。

lines.en: I should try giving her a call sometime soon...
lines.zh: 我该找个时间给她打个电话……
